mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_request(actor_type,actor_id,operation,idempotency_key,request_hash,business_no) VALUES('USER',#{userId},'PLACE_ORDER',#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash},#{orderNo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,business_no,state FROM idempotency_request WHERE actor_type='USER' AND actor_id=#{userId} AND operation='PLACE_ORDER' AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_request SET state=#{state},result_code=#{resultCode},version=version+1 WHERE business_no=#{orderNo} AND operation='PLACE_ORDER'
mapper.select: SELECT order_no,user_id,payment_no,reservation_no,request_hash,request_payload,state,result_code,created_at FROM order_creation_intent WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} FOR UPDATE

SELECT order_no,user_id,merchant_id,payment_no,reservation_no,quote_no,total_amount_cents,currency,status,stock_decision,stock_sync_status,fulfillment_lock,pay_deadline,created_at,close_phase FROM orders WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status='PENDING_PAYMENT',version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='CREATING' AND stock_decision='UNDECIDED' AND pay_deadline>UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
UPDATE orders SET status='CLOSING',stock_decision='RELEASE',close_reason=#{reason},version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='CREATING' AND stock_decision='UNDECIDED'
UPDATE orders SET status='CLOSED',stock_sync_status='RELEASED',closed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='CLOSING' AND stock_decision='RELEASE'
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) id,CAST(sku_id AS CHAR) sku_id,product_name_snapshot,spec_snapshot,unit_price_cents,quantity FROM order_item WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} ORDER BY id

SELECT unit_no,paid_amount_cents,reserved_refund_cents,succeeded_refund_cents,(paid_amount_cents-reserved_refund_cents-succeeded_refund_cents) remaining_refund_cents,return_state,(active_aftersale_no IS NOT NULL) has_active_aftersale FROM order_item_unit WHERE order_item_id=#{orderItemId} ORDER BY unit_no
SELECT order_no FROM orders WHERE status='CREATING' AND pay_deadline<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY pay_deadline,id LIMIT 30
SELECT order_no FROM orders WHERE status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND pay_deadline<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) ORDER BY pay_deadline,id LIMIT 30
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status='CLOSING',stock_decision='RELEASE',close_phase='PAYMENT_REQUIRED',close_reason=#{reason},version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND stock_decision='UNDECIDED'
UPDATE orders SET status='PAID',stock_decision='COMMIT',paid_at=#{paidAt},version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND stock_decision='UNDECIDED'
UPDATE orders SET stock_sync_status='CONFIRMED',version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='PAID' AND stock_decision='COMMIT' AND stock_sync_status='PENDING'
UPDATE orders SET close_phase='CHANNEL_CLOSED',version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='CLOSING' AND close_phase='PAYMENT_REQUIRED'

UPDATE orders SET status='CLOSING',stock_decision='RELEASE',close_phase='CHANNEL_CLOSED',close_reason=#{reason},version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status='PENDING_PAYMENT' AND stock_decision='UNDECIDED'
UPDATE orders SET close_phase='LATE_PAYMENT',close_reason='LATE_PAYMENT_REFUND_REQUIRED',version=version+1 WHERE order_no=#{orderNo} AND status IN ('CLOSING','CLOSED')
